data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, if you're already using Shopify, I'd recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers are located, and how much you sell.

## Best payment processors compared

![Für Hello Kitty Fans - Mibrix](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tOiZ9v22mWkKDkODjZ-v8UmHuYEacS351-fhJlicedtzRtyvIPyT0LbHRVsov1FwCqimbt2M5XbGmMjfcFRqoBnSC867jR1vj2Q9kN8GWqWxrNowdJCqgKFlsNcxOvUQZiEoQ3wUV3e9Iv-ULg-8O_uiwrVTYdmAuanbvrKZ5q48tOAeoqXUh_tpwPm1cZkj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- No monthly processing fee.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- Excellent fraud prevention, subscriptions and international payments.
- Great for growing businesses.

Website: [Stripe](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- Avoids additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best for customer familiarity)

- Many customers already trust it.
- Offers an alternative checkout method.
- Easy to integrate with most ecommerce platforms.
- Can be more expensive than other options.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Easy setup.
- Combines inventory and point-of-sale tools.
- Less focused on advanced ecommerce customization.

Website: [Square Canada](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

## My recommendation if you're operating in Canada

Since Canadian payment processing is relevant, here are the options I'd shortlist\:

| Processor | Best use |
|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Independent online stores |
| Shopify Payments | Stores built on Shopify |
| PayPal | Additional checkout option |
| Square | Online and physical retail |


For reference, Stripe's commonly published Canadian domestic card rate is around **2.9% + C\$0.30 per transaction**\. International cards and currency conversion can cost extra. Rates should be verified against the provider's current Canadian pricing. [primetechnolab.com](https://primetechnolab.com/website-design/e-commerce-website-development-service/payment-gateway/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/ca/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd generally start with one primary processor and add PayPal as an alternative checkout option. Avoid paying for multiple systems you don't need.

## A few questions to narrow it down

**What platform are you planning to use for your online store?**

- Shopify
- WooCommerce / WordPress
- Wix
- Squarespace
- Custom-built website
- Haven't chosen yet

I can then recommend the best processor based on fees, ease of setup, reliability, and keeping as much profit as possible from each sale.
